To increase the overall managerial remuneration of the Directors of the Company subject to the shareholders approval in the ensuing Annual General Meeting. Dear Sir, With reference to the above mentioned subject, this is to inform you that based on the recommendation of Nomination and Remuneration Committee and subject to approval of the shareholders, and any required regulatory approvals and applicable conditions thereof, a Meeting of Board of Directors of the Company was held on June 28, 2021 at the Registered Office of the Company. The Board of Directors had discussed and approved the following: 1. Approved Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the half year and year ended March 31, 2021. A copy of the results along with the Auditor s Report and declaration by the Company for the Audit Report with Unmodified Opinion is enclosed herewith. 2. Re-appointment of Nandola & Co, Practicing Chartered Accountant as Internal Auditors of the Company for the FY 2021-22. Brief Profile is enclosed as Annexure I. 3. Re-appointment of M/s. Anubhuti Tripathi & Associates, Practicing Company Secretaries, as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for the FY 2021-22. Brief Profile is enclosed as Annexure II. 4. Convening the 16th Annual General Meeting of the Company on Monday, August 24, 2021. 5. Pursuant to Regulation 42 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, The Record date will be August 16, 2021 for ascertaining names of shareholders, who will be entitled to cast their vote on the resolutions proposed. 6. Recommended the re- appointment of Mr. Amit Sheth as Managing Director of the Company and fixation of remuneration, for a further period of five (5) years w.e.f. 22nd October, 2021 to 21st October, 2026 (both days inclusive) subject to the approval of members of the Company. Brief Profile is enclosed as Annexure III. The details as required under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with SEBI Circular No. CIR/CFD/CMD/4/2015 dated 9th September, 2015 along with the brief profile is enclosed to this letter. Please note that the meeting of the Board of Directors commenced at 3.00 p.m. and concluded at 6.45 P.M. You are requested to kindly take a note of the same.
